title: Nextdoor Complaint Category Spike
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nextdoor:post category=* reaction_count=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as posts, avg(reaction_count) as avg_reactions by _time category
| eventstats avg(posts) as baseline_posts by category
| where posts>baseline_posts*1.5
| sort - posts
description: Flags Nextdoor categories whose weekly post volume exceeds one and a half times the category baseline.
value: Category spikes surface emerging block issues like noise, parking, or contractor scams before they escalate.
implementation: Include `category` on each post export and compare weekly counts to trailing baselines.
visualization: Bar chart of categories exceeding baseline post volume.
grandmaExplanation: It counts Nextdoor topics that suddenly got much more chatter than usual.
